tracks.name: RLBench · GNFactor原报告 · 20示范·最终检查点
tracks.protocol: 25 evaluation episodes/task x 3 independently trained seeds; FINAL checkpoint. Policy input front RGB-D for GNFactor/PerAct, four RGB-D cameras for explicit four-camera PerAct. Additional GNFactor training views are privileged supervision; no uniform-input fairness rank.
tracks.trainingRegime: 20 demos/task; 10-task joint model;100k steps,batch2,2 RTX3090; GNFactor adds 19 training RGB views and pretrained SD semantic teacher.

results.trainingData: 20 demos/task; 10-task joint model;100k steps,batch2,2 RTX3090; GNFactor adds 19 training RGB views and pretrained SD semantic teacher. Policy input: single front RGB-D
